places.name: Chợ Thiếc

places.name: Súp cua Cô Lan

places.name: Hủ tiếu dê Tiến Nhàn

places.name: Cơm gà Minh Ký

places.name: Tiệm bánh trung thu 187 Phạm Phú Thứ
places.noteEn: Three-generation family bakery making affordable mooncakes. Best visited before the Mid-Autumn Festival.

places.name: Quán Chay Số 7 Chợ Lớn

places.name: Mì Gia Huỳnh Lê

places.name: Chợ Nhật Tảo

places.name: Quán ăn người Hoa 147 Bình Tiên

places.name: Hủ tiếu sa tế nai Phước Vinh

places.name: Hủ tiếu mì Ngầu Ký

places.name: Huy Ký (sườn xào chua ngọt)

places.name: Sủi cảo 162 Hà Tôn Quyền

places.name: Mì vịt tiềm Sâm Ký

places.name: Mì vịt tiềm 328 Ba Đình

places.name: Mì vịt tiềm Vĩnh Phát Hong Kong

places.name: Thiêm Huy Mì Gia
places.noteEn: Started as a street cart nearly 50 years ago. A favourite for herbal duck noodles, at 455 Nguyen Trai.

places.name: Nhà hàng Hào Huê
places.noteEn: Chinese restaurant in Cholon, District 5.

places.name: BaoZ Dimsum
places.noteEn: Dim sum spot in District 5.

places.name: Dimsum 88

places.name: Chè Cột Điện
places.noteEn: Popular sweet soup (che) stall in District 5.

places.name: Shan Dimsum
places.noteEn: Small but mighty Cantonese restaurant with good-value dim sum, sweet-and-sour ribs, coconut prawns and baked crab.

places.name: Há cảo Kiều Ký

places.name: Lục Ký (hủ tiếu mì xá xíu)

places.name: Hủ tiếu vỉa hè 187 Huỳnh Mẫn Đạt
places.addr: 187 Huỳnh Mẫn Đạt, P. An Đông
places.noteEn: Cheap and tasty sidewalk hu tieu (around 30,000 dong). Evenings from 5pm.

places.name: Hủ tiếu Nam Vang Kim Khánh
places.noteEn: Hu tieu Nam Vang (Phnom Penh-style noodle soup) in central Saigon.

places.name: Hủ tiếu chay 124B Ngô Nhân Tịnh
places.noteEn: Huge pot of vegetarian noodle soup with napa cabbage and lotus seeds, served on the 1st and 15th of the lunar month, 6–9am. Expect queues.

places.name: Tô Ký – hủ tiếu sa tế nai
places.noteEn: 60-year family recipe for satay venison noodle soup at 331 Minh Phung. Open 7–11am and 5–9pm.

places.name: Bửu Lợi Ký – quán chay

places.name: Chè Hà Ký

places.name: Chè Lâm Thạnh
places.noteEn: Long-established sweet soup shop in District 5.

places.name: Cà phê số 1 Tản Đà
places.noteEn: Café filled with antiques and gemstones, where collectors meet to trade.

places.name: Chuyện Cà Phê
places.noteEn: Neighbourhood café at 70 Street 5, Binh Phu.

places.name: Tiệm nước CIELO Chợ Lớn
places.noteEn: Cute drinks shop in Cholon.

places.name: Chợ Bình Tây
places.noteEn: Cholon's century-old wholesale market. A busy, colourful place to see Chinatown trading life.

places.name: Nhà hàng Ái Huê
places.noteEn: Classic Cholon restaurant for a Sunday dim sum feast.

places.name: Mì bò 180 Trần Hưng Đạo

places.noteEn: Busy beef-noodle shop on Tran Hung Dao that grew to five branches after a viral review.

places.name: Hủ Tíu Mì 47
places.noteEn: Third-generation Chinese-Vietnamese noodle family, newly opened on Hong Bang; noodles come with braised pork hock or braised ribs.

places.name: Bánh bột người Hoa 182 Lò Siêu
places.noteEn: Chinese-Vietnamese rice-flour cake (bánh bột) stall that has been selling for over 50 years, still at about 12,000 dong.

places.addr: 213 Trần Quý, P. Minh Phụng (Quận 11 cũ)
places.noteEn: Chinese-Vietnamese broken rice (cơm tấm) breakfast spot that is busy every morning.

places.name: Tiệm cơm Chấn Phát
places.noteEn: Long-running, affordable Chinese-Vietnamese rice shop with a long menu of home-style dishes.

places.name: Hủ tiếu hồ chay người Hoa 35K
places.addr: Q22 Nguyễn Hữu Hào, Quận 4 cũ
places.noteEn: Chinese-Vietnamese vegetarian stall serving hủ tiếu hồ (wide rice noodles) from 35,000 dong a bowl.

places.name: Hủ tiếu bò kho Tôn Thất Thuyết
places.nameEn: Ton That Thuyet Beef Stew Noodles

places.noteEn: Roadside cart run by a couple near Chợ 200 in District 4, serving noodles in beef stew (bò kho).

places.name: Hủ tíu Mỹ Kim

places.noteEn: Alley noodle shop in District 3 where the owner tosses the noodles with flair; shrimp, fish, kidney and pork bone toppings, in soup or dry.

places.name: Bánh mì Hòa Mã

places.name: Bánh mì Hồng Hoa

places.noteEn: Banh mi shop on Nguyen Van Trang near Ben Thanh Market and the backpacker area, featured in a Mark Wiens street food video.
